senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) hired mourner, speaker at funerals or memorial services.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 8a:19">M. Kat. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בא ס׳ וכ׳</he> a wailer came and placed himself at the door (offering his services).—Pl. <he>סַפְדָּנִים</he>, <he>סַפְדָּנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:16">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>כשם … מן הס׳ וכ׳</he> as the dead are called to account (for their deeds), so the wailers and those who respond after them will be made responsible (for their eulogies).
